facts.statement: The genus Palaeospiza was described by Allen in 1878.
Palaeospiza bella lived in what is now Colorado during the Eocene and Oligocene epochs.
facts.quote: Palaeospiza bella lived in what is now Colorado in the Eocene and Oligocene.

facts.statement: The genus Palaeospiza existed from 37.71 to 33.9 million years ago during the Priabonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Priabonian to Priabonian (37.71 to 33.9 million years ago)
